Raw Operational Requirements Document:
We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices. It is particularly important to us that the app runs quickly and smoothly so that it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting. With our app, we want to offer football fans a central platform where they can stay comprehensively informed at all times. To achieve this, users can display current football news of their favorite teams and also select preferred sports channels individually. In addition to the news, users can follow the results of their favorite teams live via a live ticker. Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international. Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time. Another highlight is the integration of live stream links, for example, from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport. These are available directly in the app as soon as the live broadcast has begun. Of course, it is ensured that compliance with transmission rights is maintained. Live streams will only be displayed when the respective rights are fulfilled in the country. The LiveFootball app should also give users the option to retrieve the live results of their favorite teams in real time. To implement this function, the app includes an integrated live ticker module that enables the retrieval and display of live data in real time. The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly. The user interface is a key component of the app and connects various modules that are displayed together and managed via the interface. The live ticker module communicates directly via the interface with the user interface to display and continuously update current match data. The live data is retrieved via an API from an external server. The server is located outside the app and provides the data dynamically so that the live ticker module can access it flexibly. In addition to the live ticker module, the app also offers additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app and connect their own interface to the user interface. Furthermore, the app is linked to a notification system that provides users with information about current events as soon as the notification function is activated. All modules and the user interface are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates. Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup. Users have the option to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams. In addition, users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app. We are aware that many mobile apps have to operate under difficult conditions. Therefore, the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage. The app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection. On match days with a particularly high number of accesses, our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss. To prevent technical problems, the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early. In addition, user feedback and app reviews are continuously evaluated to improve functionality. Data protection is our highest priority. All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR.

## Section 1: Scope & Functional Architecture

### 1.1 Scope

The LiveFootball mobile app is a free, account-based platform for football fans, available on Android and iOS. Its primary functions are to provide fast, reliable, and comprehensive football news, live scores, team/player information, and live stream links, with a strong emphasis on user experience, personalization, and data privacy. The system boundary includes all user-facing modules (news, live ticker, notifications, personalization, social sharing), the user interface, and backend integrations (APIs, notification system). The app excludes administrative roles, paid features, and non-football content.

### 1.2 Functional Architecture Overview

**Core Modules:**
- Authentication & Account Management
- News & Content Aggregation
- Live Ticker & Match Data
- Team & Player Information
- Personalization & Notification System
- Live Streaming Integration
- Social Sharing
- Offline & Performance Management
- Feedback & Support
- Data Privacy & Security

**Integration Points:**
- External APIs for live data, news, and streams
- Notification delivery system
- Social media sharing APIs

---

## Section 2: Functional Requirements Breakdown

### 2.1 Authentication & Account Management

- **FR-001:** The system SHALL require users to register an account with a valid email address and password before granting access to any app features.
- **FR-002:** The system SHALL provide a login interface that allows registered users to authenticate using their credentials.
- **FR-003:** The system SHALL ensure the registration and login process can be completed within 30 seconds under normal network conditions.
- **FR-004:** The system SHALL store user credentials securely using industry-standard encryption.

### 2.2 News, Scores & Live Ticker

- **FR-005:** The system SHALL display current football news relevant to the user's selected favorite teams on the home screen.
- **FR-006:** The system SHALL allow users to select and modify their favorite teams and preferred sports channels at any time.
- **FR-007:** The system SHALL retrieve and display live match results for the user's favorite teams via a live ticker module.
- **FR-008:** The system SHALL provide real-time updates to the live ticker by polling or subscribing to an external live data API.
- **FR-009:** The system SHALL offer comprehensive coverage of all major national and international football leagues and competitions.
- **FR-010:** The system SHALL display detailed team and player information, including statistics, profiles, and recent performance.

### 2.3 Personalization & Notifications

- **FR-011:** The system SHALL allow users to configure notification preferences for news, match events, and results related to their favorite teams.
- **FR-012:** The system SHALL send push notifications to users based on their configured preferences when relevant events occur.
- **FR-013:** The system SHALL allow users to enable or disable notifications at any time from the settings menu.

### 2.4 Live Streaming & Media

- **FR-014:** The system SHALL display live stream links for matches when a live broadcast is available and the user’s country has the necessary transmission rights.
- **FR-015:** The system SHALL verify transmission rights based on the user’s location before displaying live stream links.
- **FR-016:** The system SHALL provide direct access to external live stream providers (e.g., DAZN, Sky Sport) via in-app links.

### 2.5 User Interface & Usability

- **FR-017:** The system SHALL fully load and display the main interface within two seconds of app launch under normal network conditions.
- **FR-018:** The system SHALL provide a clear, intuitive, and consistent user interface across all modules.
- **FR-019:** The system SHALL allow users to configure the layout and appearance of the app interface according to their preferences.

### 2.6 Social Sharing

- **FR-020:** The system SHALL allow users to share news articles and match reports directly to social media platforms (e.g., Twitter, Facebook, WhatsApp) from within the app.

### 2.7 Performance, Reliability & Offline Use

- **FR-021:** The system SHALL function reliably with limited network coverage, providing cached content when live data is unavailable.
- **FR-022:** The system SHALL allow users to access previously loaded news, scores, and team/player information while offline.
- **FR-023:** The system SHALL support at least 100,000 concurrent users without performance degradation during peak usage (e.g., match days).
- **FR-024:** The system SHALL perform automated and manual testing before each release to detect and resolve malfunctions.

### 2.8 Data Privacy & Security

- **FR-025:** The system SHALL process and store all personal user data in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
- **FR-026:** The system SHALL provide users with access to a privacy policy and options to manage their data (e.g., delete account, export data).

### 2.9 Feedback & Support

- **FR-027:** The system SHALL provide an in-app mechanism for users to submit feedback and report issues.
- **FR-028:** The system SHALL log and categorize user feedback for continuous evaluation and improvement.

---

## Section 3: Input/Output Data Dictionary & Business Logic Rules

### 3.1 Input/Output Data Dictionary

| Data Element           | Source/Input           | Output/Usage                | Description                                      |
|------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| Email Address          | User Registration     | Account Creation/Login      | Unique identifier for user account               |
| Password               | User Registration     | Account Creation/Login      | Used for authentication, stored encrypted        |
| Favorite Teams         | User Selection        | Personalization, News, Ticker | Teams user follows for personalized content      |
| Preferred Channels     | User Selection        | Personalization, News       | Sports channels user prefers                     |
| Notification Settings  | User Configuration    | Notification System         | User preferences for push notifications          |
| Location Data          | Device (with consent) | Live Stream Rights Check    | Used to verify transmission rights               |
| News Articles          | External API          | News Module                 | Football news content                            |
| Live Match Data        | External API          | Live Ticker Module          | Real-time scores and events                      |
| Team/Player Info       | External API          | Info Module                 | Stats, profiles, and history                     |
| Social Media Share     | User Action           | Social Media API            | News/reports shared externally                   |
| Feedback Submission    | User Input            | Support System              | User feedback and issue reports                  |

### 3.2 Business Logic Rules

- **BL-001:** Only registered and authenticated users may access any app features.
- **BL-002:** News, live scores, and notifications are filtered based on the user's selected favorite teams and channels.
- **BL-003:** Live stream links are displayed only if the user’s location matches the transmission rights for the event.
- **BL-004:** Cached data is used for offline access; live data is refreshed when connectivity is restored.
- **BL-005:** User credentials and personal data are encrypted and processed in compliance with GDPR.
- **BL-006:** The app must not exceed a two-second load time under normal network conditions.
- **BL-007:** The app must support at least 100,000 concurrent users without performance degradation.
- **BL-008:** User feedback is logged, categorized, and reviewed regularly for product improvement.

## Section 2: Detailed User Stories with Gherkin Acceptance Criteria

---

### EPIC-01: User Authentication & Account Management

#### US-001: Registration and Login
**As a General Football Fan, I want to register and log in to the app so that I can access personalized football content securely.**  
**Priority:** High | **Story Points:** 5

**AC-001:**  
- **Given** the app is launched for the first time  
- **When** the user opens the app  
- **Then** the registration/login screen is displayed and no other features are accessible until login is completed

**AC-002:**  
- **Given** the user enters valid credentials  
- **When** the user submits the login form  
- **Then** the user is granted access to the main dashboard

**AC-003:**  
- **Given** the user enters invalid credentials  
- **When** the user submits the login form  
- **Then** a clear error message is displayed and access is denied

**AC-004:**  
- **Given** the user has forgotten their password  
- **When** the user selects "Forgot Password" and enters their email  
- **Then** a password reset link is sent to the provided email

---

### EPIC-02: Personalization & Notification System

#### US-002: Select Favorite Teams and Leagues
**As a General Football Fan, I want to select my favorite teams and leagues so that I receive relevant news and updates.**  
**Priority:** High | **Story Points:** 3

**AC-005:**  
- **Given** the user is logged in  
- **When** the user completes onboarding or accesses settings  
- **Then** the user can select one or more favorite teams and leagues

**AC-006:**  
- **Given** the user has selected favorite teams/leagues  
- **When** news or live updates are available  
- **Then** the app prioritizes and displays content related to those selections

#### US-003: Configure Notification Preferences
**As a Power User, I want to configure notification preferences so that I am alerted only to events I care about.**  
**Priority:** Medium | **Story Points:** 3

**AC-007:**  
- **Given** the user is in the notification settings  
- **When** the user enables or disables specific notification types (e.g., match events, news, results)  
- **Then** only the selected notifications are sent to the user

**AC-008:**  
- **Given** the user disables all notifications  
- **When** a relevant event occurs  
- **Then** the user does not receive any push notification

---

### EPIC-03: News, Live Ticker & Data Integration

#### US-004: View Current Football News
**As a General Football Fan, I want to view current football news for my favorite teams so that I can stay informed about relevant updates.**  
**Priority:** High | **Story Points:** 3

**AC-009:**  
- **Given** the user is logged in and on the news screen  
- **When** the app loads news articles  
- **Then** news relevant to the user's favorite teams is displayed at the top

#### US-005: Access Live Ticker with Real-Time Results
**As a Power User, I want access to a live ticker with real-time match results so that I can follow games as they happen.**  
**Priority:** High | **Story Points:** 5

**AC-010:**  
- **Given** a match involving a favorite team is in progress  
- **When** the user opens the live ticker  
- **Then** live scores and match events are updated in real time with a maximum delay of 1 second from the data source

**AC-011:**  
- **Given** the user is offline  
- **When** the user opens the live ticker  
- **Then** the most recently cached match data is displayed and the UI indicates offline mode

---

### EPIC-04: Team & Player Information

#### US-006: View Detailed Team and Player Information
**As a General Football Fan, I want to see detailed team and player information so that I can learn more about the teams and players I follow.**  
**Priority:** Medium | **Story Points:** 3

**AC-012:**  
- **Given** the user selects a team or player from the UI  
- **When** the team/player info screen loads  
- **Then** detailed statistics, bios, and historical data are displayed

---

### EPIC-05: Live Streaming & Transmission Rights

#### US-007: Access Live Stream Links for Matches
**As a General Football Fan, I want access to live stream links for matches so that I can watch games directly from the app when available.**  
**Priority:** High | **Story Points:** 5

**AC-013:**  
- **Given** a live broadcast has started and the user's country is authorized  
- **When** the user opens the match details  
- **Then** a live stream link is displayed and accessible

**AC-014:**  
- **Given** the user's country is not authorized for the broadcast  
- **When** the user opens the match details  
- **Then** the live stream link is hidden or disabled

---

### EPIC-06: User Interface & Usability

#### US-008: Fast App Loading and Intuitive Navigation
**As an Occasional User, I want the app to load quickly and have a clear interface so that I can find information easily.**  
**Priority:** High | **Story Points:** 5

**AC-015:**  
- **Given** the user launches the app under normal network conditions  
- **When** the app starts  
- **Then** the main dashboard is fully loaded and interactive within 2 seconds

**AC-016:**  
- **Given** the user is on any screen  
- **When** the user uses the navigation bar  
- **Then** the app transitions smoothly between modules (news, live ticker, teams, settings)

---

### EPIC-07: Social Sharing

#### US-009: Share News and Match Reports via Social Media
**As a General Football Fan, I want to share news and match reports via social media so that I can engage with my network.**  
**Priority:** Medium | **Story Points:** 2

**AC-017:**  
- **Given** the user is viewing a news article or match report  
- **When** the user taps the share button  
- **Then** the system presents sharing options for supported social media platforms

---

### EPIC-08: Offline & Performance Management

#### US-010: Offline Usability and Data Caching
**As a General Football Fan, I want the app to remain usable offline so that I can access previously loaded information without a connection.**  
**Priority:** High | **Story Points:** 5

**AC-018:**  
- **Given** the user has previously loaded news, scores, or team/player data  
- **When** the device is offline  
- **Then** the app displays cached content and indicates offline status

**AC-019:**  
- **Given** the device regains network connectivity  
- **When** the app is open  
- **Then** live data is automatically refreshed and the UI returns to online mode

#### US-011: High Concurrent User Support
**As a Power User, I want the app to support high concurrent usage so that performance is not degraded on match days.**  
**Priority:** High | **Story Points:** 8

**AC-020:**  
- **Given** up to 100,000 users are active simultaneously  
- **When** the app is in use during peak times  
- **Then** the app remains responsive and all core features are available without noticeable performance loss

---

### EPIC-09: Data Privacy & Security

#### US-012: GDPR-Compliant Data Processing
**As a General Football Fan, I want assurance that my personal data is processed in compliance with GDPR so that my privacy is protected.**  
**Priority:** High | **Story Points:** 5

**AC-021:**  
- **Given** the user is registering for the app  
- **When** the registration form is displayed  
- **Then** the privacy policy is shown and user consent is required before account creation

**AC-022:**  
- **Given** the user requests data export or account deletion  
- **When** the user submits a request via the app  
- **Then** the system provides the requested data or deletes the account and associated data in compliance with GDPR

---

### EPIC-10: Feedback, Support & Continuous Improvement

#### US-013: In-App Feedback Mechanism
**As a General Football Fan, I need a way to provide feedback and report issues so that the app can be improved over time.**  
**Priority:** Medium | **Story Points:** 2

**AC-023:**  
- **Given** the user is logged in  
- **When** the user navigates to the feedback/support section  
- **Then** the user can submit feedback or report issues directly from the app

---

**End of User Stories Document**
